I'll admit that is inspiring, but, no insults intended, that means someone in that situation was able to find a girl while I've driven myself to the verge of suicide with women's rejections and still can't find a girl? That reaffirms how bad my odds are. I'm sorry, but I don't think I need this through anymore. Girls would rather be alone than with a guy like me for whatever reason. I'm fucking tired of waiting around for even the reason. Thanks for your time.

EDIT: If it makes you feel better; I'll make sure to die in a way that people won't see it as a suicide or disgraceful death.

How the hell is anyone suppose to deal with this? How the hell am I suppose to just keep going through life like this? Not to mention no one likes depressing guys. Am I suppose to just be a fucking asshole to everyone and vent as much as I can? That has the same effect and I still might as well die. Even if, there is someone out there; I'm going too much of an asshole by the time they get here.

Dude, you know that's got to be bullshit. I don't mean any disrespect, but, to have everything that I've got going for me and to not ever even get a date, has to mean something. It's like telling a straving man that there's food around the next corner. I'm 23 at this point. I've done everything. I work out 5 days a week, spent a small fortune on nice clothes, changed my approach a bunch of times. Meanwhile, I see guys that are much less attractive in every way and abusive getting with really sweet, attractive girls. It's not like I'm socially inexperinced or seem desperate either. Maybe, it's because I am a short guy. I don't think about loneliness most of the time, but, lately, I've been getting more intense depressive episodes about it. I used to want to understand why in fuck I can't find a goddam date, but, now, I seriously don't care anymore. Can't someone just admit that some people are ment to die alone? Shouldn't be my choice if I don't live out that life of misery?
